mechanismOfAction.summary: GABA-A positive allosteric modulator (triazolobenzodiazepine); in-silico QSAR suggests high potency. First described 1970s (Sternbach); never marketed.
mechanismOfAction.description: Triazolo-fused 1,4-benzodiazepine; enhances GABA-A chloride currents at the benzodiazepine site. In-silico QSAR indicates triazolobenzodiazepines are among the most potent BZD subclass. No published binding affinity data; no human pharmacokinetic data. First described by Sternbach in the 1970s; never developed or marketed.
